description: This file defines a 'MigrationContext' class used for managing serialization and deserialization of data segments, with support for adding, retrieving, and enumerating stored byte sequences, and tracking them via keys within a migration process.

classes.name: MigrationContext
classes.description: A class responsible for managing migration data, including serializing and deserializing byte sequences, and maintaining indices for stored data.

classes.name: MigrationContext.SerializationHooks
classes.description: A nested class providing hooks for the deserialization process, specifically to initialize the session pool.

methods.name: AddBytes
methods.description: Adds a byte array to the buffer under a specified key.

methods.name: AddBytes<T>
methods.description: Uses a writer function to serialize a value of type T into the buffer under a key.

methods.name: TryAddValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to serialize a value of type T into the buffer and store its position with a key.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Cleans up resources, resetting the buffer.

methods.name: TryGetBytes
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the byte sequence associated with a key.

methods.name: TryGetValue<T>
methods.description: Attempts to deserialize a value of type T associated with a key.
